log: THE DATA LEDGER -- every external input, where it came from, and how to get it back
Four inputs nexus_txn needs were absent from this container, so a recorded result could be
read but not checked. Recovering them took a Zenodo search, three ENCODE queries, a GEO
crawl and a rebuild from a different predictor. That knowledge lived only in commit
messages. This file makes it executable.
REBUILD CHECK -- a derived file must reproduce its hash from its raw inputs, or the
recorded transform is not the one that made it
Every derived file rebuilds bit-identically. The transforms in this file ARE the ones
that produced them, so the provenance claim is checkable rather than asserted.
TO RESTORE ANYTHING MISSING:  python3 colab/data_ledger.py --fetch <name|all>
NOT IN THIS LEDGER, and it is the biggest remaining hole: cell_complete.json is 38 MB,
read by 227 modules, gitignored, and has no external source to fetch from. It is a
DERIVED artefact whose producer is not in this repo -- the same condition as _abcfeat.json
before today, but with nothing to rebuild it from. A ledger cannot fix that; only
recovering or rewriting its builder can.
